headline: Fusion CX AGM on December 14, 2026 via VC/OAVM
summary: Fusion CX Limited has scheduled its 23rd AGM for December 14, 2026 at 5:00 pm (IST) through VC/OAVM, with the notice and FY26 annual report issued on November 21, 2026. The agenda includes a revised dividend of ₹0.75 per equity share and proposed changes to the statutory auditor and board composition.

headline: Skytech wins Rs 2.2 Cr order from RWSSB Karnataka
summary: Skytech Infinite Platform secured a Rs 2.2 crore work order for PLC automation systems in Gulbarga. This adds to Q3FY27 inflows, bringing the quarter's total to Rs 36.23 crore.

headline: Anlon Tech wins Rs 0.61 Cr order for runway rubber removal
summary: Anlon Technology Solutions secured a Rs 61.38 lakh contract from a confidential B2B client for runway rubber removal services. This order adds to Q1FY27 inflows, supporting the company's service revenue growth trajectory.

headline: Mayasheel wins Rs 38.23 Cr subcontract from Rajshree
summary: Mayasheel Ventures secures Rs 38.23 Cr back-to-back subcontract for Greater Noida drain project. Order book coverage remains robust with recent inflows.

headline: Maruti Suzuki hikes prices by 0.31% for select models
summary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited announced a price increase of approximately 0.31% for select models effective November 22, 2026, citing sustained cost pressures.

headline: Dhara Rail wins Rs 0.54 Cr order from Indian Railways
summary: Dhara Rail Projects secured a Rs 54.28 lakh contract for Vande Bharat maintenance. Order book coverage remains robust with strong inflow velocity in Q1FY27.

headline: Acme Solar wins Rs 50 lakh GUVNL order for 50 MW RE project
summary: Acme Solar Holdings secured a Rs 50 lakh order from GUVNL for 50 MW firm and dispatchable power. Book-to-bill is low at 0.18x, but quarterly revenue shows strong growth with high OPM.

headline: RVNL wins Rs 348 Cr order from East Coast Railway
summary: Rail Vikas Nigam secures Rs 348.48 crore work order for wagon workshop augmentation. Order book coverage stands at 0.28 quarters. Recent inflow velocity shows deceleration in Q3FY27 compared to Q1FY27.

headline: Lodha Developers director Mukund Chitale ceases office
summary: Mukund Chitale ceased to be Independent Director and Chairman of Lodha Developers on November 22, 2026, after completing his second term. Akhil Gupta assumes both roles.
